user.title: Flexible Map
user.description: Keeps a location history file and adds a Flexible Map dashboard to your sidebar. Nothing to fill in, just press Submit.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Flexible Map is already set up.

init.title: Flexible Map settings
init.description: Leave the tracked list empty to record every person.

data.min_distance_m: Only save a point after moving at least (m)
data.min_seconds: Only save a point at least this far apart in time (s)
data.max_accuracy_m: Ignore points less accurate than (m, 0 = off)
data.retention_days: Delete history older than (days, 0 = keep forever)
data.heartbeat_minutes: While standing still, still save a point every (minutes, 0 = off)
data.stop_minutes: A stop on the timeline is at least (minutes)
data.create_sensors: Create "place" and "distance today" sensors for each person
data.ingest_enabled: Turn on the ingest URL (OwnTracks, Overland, other apps)
